Previous Next Frequently asked questions Is Coursera accredited, and are Coursera certificates recognized by employers? Coursera partners with accredited universities and leading companies such as Google and IBM to offer courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. Employers widely recognize these credentials because they are issued directly by trusted institutions. Learners can build job-ready skills with the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate , the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate , or start with accredited university content in high-demand fields like data analytics and cybersecurity . Is a Coursera certificate worth it? For many learners, a Coursera certificate is worth it because it provides job-ready skills and a verifiable credential from respected universities and companies. Learners commonly transition into roles in project management, UX design, and data science through programs such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate , the Google UX Design Professional Certificate , and the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate . Others enter technical fields by starting with beginner-friendly Python or generative AI courses. What is Coursera Plus, and is it worth it? Coursera Plus is an annual subscription that gives learners unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. It’s a substantial value for anyone planning to complete multiple programs in a year. Learners often use Coursera Plus to explore in-demand areas, such as AI and analytics, through programs like the AI Essentials Specialization , the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate , or the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate . Does Coursera offer free online courses? Yes. Coursera offers thousands of courses that you can preview for free, including access to the first module, allowing you to explore the content before committing. Learners who want full course access or a certificate can join with a 7-day free trial through Coursera Plus or a subscription-based program. Many learners begin with introductory topics, such as Python , digital marketing , or English speaking , and later move into job-focused programs, like the Google IT Support Professional Certificate , when they’re ready to complete a credential. What are the most popular courses on Coursera? Coursera’s best-known courses and certificates are offered by leading universities and companies in the fields of AI, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering. Many learners begin with the Machine Learning Specialization or the Deep Learning Specialization . In contrast, others opt for job-aligned pathways, such as the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate or the AI Engineer Professional Certificate . You can also browse broad areas, such as artificial intelligence , SQL , or web development , to find highly rated options. How can Coursera help me get a job or advance my career? Coursera offers job-aligned Professional Certificates and Specializations designed in collaboration with employers and universities to help learners qualify for roles in fields such as cybersecurity, UX, data analytics, AI, and business. Programs such as the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate , the Data Analysis with Python Specialization , and the UI/UX Design Specialization help learners build employer-relevant skills. At the same time, many career changers explore areas such as product management or business analysis as pathways into business and technology roles. Coursera also offers online bachelor’s and master’s degrees from accredited universities, which can support long-term career advancement in business, computer science, data, and other high-growth fields. Learners exploring formal education pathways can browse online degrees or view available bachelor’s programs to find a degree aligned to their career goals. What is Coursera for Business, and how much does it cost? Coursera for Business is Coursera’s enterprise learning platform designed to help organizations reskill and upskill employees with job-relevant training from top universities and companies. It comes in two versions: Coursera for Teams – Designed for small teams and growing businesses. It offers access to thousands of courses and Professional Certificates for a fixed price per user. Coursera for Enterprise – Built for large organizations that need advanced features, including analytics, integrations, skills benchmarking, and scalable workforce training programs tailored to specific roles. Pricing varies depending on the size of your team and the learning needs of your organization. mainEntity.name: Is Coursera accredited, and are Coursera certificates recognized by employers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coursera partners with accredited universities and leading companies such as Google and IBM to offer courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. Employers widely recognize these credentials because they are issued directly by trusted institutions. Learners can build job-ready skills with the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, or start with accredited university content in high-demand fields like data analytics and cybersecurity.

mainEntity.name: Is a Coursera certificate worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: For many learners, a Coursera certificate is worth it because it provides job-ready skills and a verifiable credential from respected universities and companies. Learners commonly transition into roles in project management, UX design, and data science through programs such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, and the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate. Others enter technical fields by starting with beginner-friendly Python or generative AI courses.

mainEntity.name: What is Coursera Plus, and is it worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coursera Plus is an annual subscription that gives learners unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. It’s a substantial value for anyone planning to complete multiple programs in a year. Learners often use Coursera Plus to explore in-demand areas, such as AI and analytics, through programs like the AI Essentials Specialization, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, or the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate.

mainEntity.name: Does Coursera offer free online courses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Coursera offers thousands of courses that you can preview for free, including access to the first module, allowing you to explore the content before committing. Learners who want full course access or a certificate can join with a 7-day free trial through Coursera Plus or a subscription-based program. Many learners begin with introductory topics, such as Python, digital marketing, or English speaking, and later move into job-focused programs, like the Google IT Support Professional Certificate, when they’re ready to complete a credential.

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular courses on Coursera?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coursera’s best-known courses and certificates are offered by leading universities and companies in the fields of AI, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering. Many learners begin with the Machine Learning Specialization or the Deep Learning Specialization. In contrast, others opt for job-aligned pathways, such as the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate or the AI Engineer Professional Certificate. You can also browse broad areas, such as artificial intelligence, SQL, or web development, to find highly rated options.

mainEntity.name: How can Coursera help me get a job or advance my career?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Coursera offers job-aligned Professional Certificates and Specializations designed in collaboration with employers and universities to help learners qualify for roles in fields such as cybersecurity, UX, data analytics, AI, and business. Programs such as the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization help learners build employer-relevant skills. At the same time, many career changers explore areas such as product management or business analysis as pathways into business and technology roles.
Coursera also offers online bachelor’s and master’s degrees from accredited universities, which can support long-term career advancement in business, computer science, data, and other high-growth fields. Learners exploring formal education pathways can browse online degrees or view available bachelor’s programs to find a degree aligned to their career goals.

mainEntity.name: What is Coursera for Business, and how much does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coursera for Business is Coursera’s enterprise learning platform designed to help organizations reskill and upskill employees with job-relevant training from top universities and companies. It comes in two versions:Coursera for Teams – Designed for small teams and growing businesses. It offers access to thousands of courses and Professional Certificates for a fixed price per user.Coursera for Enterprise – Built for large organizations that need advanced features, including analytics, integrations, skills benchmarking, and scalable workforce training programs tailored to specific roles.Pricing varies depending on the size of your team and the learning needs of your organization. Small businesses can purchase Coursera for Teams directly online, while Coursera for Enterprise pricing is custom and available through a sales consultation.

Coursera’s platform innovations — including AI-powered personalized guide and features, like Role Play and Course Builder, and role-based solutions like Skills Tracks — enable instructors, partners, and companies to deliver scalable, personalized, and verified learning. Institutions worldwide rely on Coursera to upskill and reskill their employees, students, and citizens in high-demand fields such as GenAI, data science, technology, and business, while learners globally turn to Coursera to master the skills they need to advance their careers. https://www.coursera.org/about.visible_text: About Coursera | Coursera For Individuals For Businesses For Universities For Governments Explore Degrees ​ Log In Join for Free Join for Free Explore degrees from the world’s top universities on Coursera. We envision a world where anyone, anywhere has the power to transform their lives through learning. Learn from leading universities and companies Coursera partners with more than 375 leading universities and companies to bring flexible, affordable, job-relevant online learning to individuals and organizations worldwide. We offer a range of learning opportunities — from hands-on projects and courses to job-ready certificates and degree programs. We believe Learning is the source of human progress. It has the power to transform our world from illness to health, from poverty to prosperity, from conflict to peace. It has the power to transform our lives for ourselves, for our families, for our communities. No matter who we are or where we are, learning empowers us to change and grow and redefine what’s possible. That’s why access to the best learning is a right, not a privilege. And that’s why Coursera is here. We partner with the best institutions to bring the best learning to every corner of the world. So that anyone, anywhere has the power to transform their lives through learning. Join the community and start learning today Take the next step toward your personal and professional goals with Coursera. Join now How Coursera Works Our Story Coursera was launched in 2012 by Andrew Ng and Daphne Koller with a mission to provide universal access to world-class learning. Coursera partners with leading university and industry partners to offer a broad catalog of content and credentials, including courses, Specializations, Professional Certificates, and degrees. Coursera’s platform innovations — including AI-powered personalized guide and features, like Role Play and Course Builder, and role-based solutions like Skills Tracks — enable instructors, partners, and companies to deliver scalable, personalized, and verified learning. Institutions worldwide rely on Coursera to upskill and reskill their employees, students, and citizens in high-demand fields such as GenAI, data science, technology, and business, while learners globally turn to Coursera to master the skills they need to advance their careers. Coursera is a Delaware public benefit corporation and a B Corp. Coursera recently combined with Udemy to create one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms. Effective product management helps companies innovate, respond to market changes, and deliver value to customers, making it essential for business success. ‎ What jobs can I get with Product Management skills? ‎ In product management, a variety of job roles are available, including Product Manager, Product Owner, and Product Marketing Manager. id="0-what-is-capm-certification">What is CAPM certification? </h2><p>The Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)® certification is a credential designed to demonstrate entry-level project management competency. It is administered by the Project Management Institute (PMI), a leading worldwide organization in project management. This certificate can also be used as a stepping stone to the <a href="https://www.coursera.org/articles/the-pmp-certification-a-guide-to-getting-started" target="_self" rel="">Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification</a>. </p><h2 id="1-capm-requirements">CAPM requirements</h2><p>You’ll need to meet the following requirements to sit for the CAPM exam:</p><p></p><p></p><ul><li><p>A high school diploma, GED, associate degree, or equivalent</p></li><li><p>23 hours of project management education completed before the time of the exam</p></li></ul><p></p><p>Once you've completed at least 23 hours of education, you're qualified to take the exam. The CAPM exam contains <b>150 questions</b> and you’ll have <b>three hours</b> to complete it. </p><h3>What counts as 23 hours of project management education?</h3><p>You may search for in-person courses at your local community college or take online project management programs, such as the <a href="https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/google-project-management" target="_self" rel="">Google Project Management Professional Certificate</a>. Throughout this series, you'll focus on core project management skills and methodologies like Agile, risk management, project execution, business writing, and effective communication. </p><div data-testid="articles_entity_card_placeholder" class="css-7fw49w"><div class="css-1oiads2"><div class="css-1pxcih2"><div class="css-1ft77rc"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-rect css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true" style="width:60px;height:60px"></span></div><div class="css-1wb72u0"><p class="css-vac8rf"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true"></span></p><h3 class="cds-119 cds-Typography-base css-h1jogs cds-121"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true"></span></h3></div><div class="product-card-subtitle-skeleton"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-rect css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true"></span></div><div class="css-evvwsy"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-rect css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true" style="width:300px;height:30px"></span></div><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true" style="height:50px"></span></div><div class="css-1g2hgk0"><p class="css-6ecy9b"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true" style="width:200px;height:20px"></span></p><p class="css-vac8rf"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true"></span></p><p class="skills-title css-6ecy9b"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true" style="width:200px;height:40px"></span></p><p class="css-vac8rf"><span class="cds-Skeleton-root cds-Skeleton-text css-k5mpyx" aria-hidden="true" style="width:200px;height:40px"></span></p></div></div></div><h3>How much does a CAPM certification cost?</h3><p>The CAPM exam costs $225 for PMI members and $300 for non-members [<a href="https://www.pmi.org/certifications/certified-associate-capm" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1</a>]. Becoming a PMI member costs $129 a year, plus a one-time $10 application fee. Membership includes perks such as a complimentary download of the PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) Guide, lower costs for other career-advancing certifications, and access to a project management job board. </p><h2 id="2-is-the-capm-certification-worth-it-for-your-career">Is the CAPM certification worth it for your career?</h2><p>Certifications are a great way to improve your job performance, confidence in the workplace, and competitiveness as an applicant. If you're unsure whether or not the CAPM certification aligns with your career goals, consider browsing job postings for careers you'd like to pursue. </p><p>If the skills match the ones being tested in the CAPM exam or employers ask for the CAPM by name, earning the certificate can help you meet those expectations. In the following sections, you can learn more about jobs that benefit from or specifically request CAPM certification and their respective salaries.</p><h3>Entry-level project management jobs</h3><p>The CAPM can prepare you for entry-level project management jobs, such as <a href="https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-does-a-project-coordinator-do" target="_self" rel="">project coordinator</a> and associate project manager.</p><p>Project management is a growing career field. According to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), the job outlook for project management specialists is expected to grow 6 percent between 2024 and 2034, faster than the average for all occupations [<a href="https://www.bls.gov/ooh/business-and-financial/project-management-specialists.htm" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">2</a>]. In a report published by the PMI, the project-oriented job market is projected to grow 33 percent, equivalent to 22 million new jobs, and by 2027, employers are projected to need almost 88 million project management roles [<a href="https://www.pmi.org/learning/careers/job-growth" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">3</a>].</p><h3>How much does a CAPM certification increase salary?</h3><p>According to Payscale, a Certified Associate in Project Management makes an average salary of $77,000 in the US as of October 2025 [<a href="https://www.payscale.com/research/US/Certification=Certified_Associate_in_Project_Management_(CAPM)/Salary?loggedIn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">4</a>]. Below are some of the average US salaries for positions listing CAPM certification in job postings, collected from Glassdoor. </p><div class="rc-Markdown styled rc-ArticleTable"><table><thead><tr><th>Position</th><th>Salary</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Project coordinator</td><td>$62,848</td></tr><tr><td>Junior project manager</td><td>$66,303</td></tr><tr><td>Associate project manager</td><td>$77,335</td></tr><tr><td>Project analyst</td><td>$73,940</td></tr><tr><td>Project manager</td><td>$89,260</td></tr><tr><td>Project control specialist</td><td>$98,260</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p><b>Read more:</b> <a href="https://www.coursera.org/articles/project-manager-salary" target="_self" rel="">Project Manager Salary: Your 2024 Guide</a></p><div class="rc-ArticleHighlight cds"><div class="css-1jke4yk"><div class="css-1t29d8p"><div class="css-153qjmo"><div><h3>Should I get the CAPM or PMP?</h3><p>Whether you should get the CAPM vs. PMP depends on your goals. CAPM certification makes sense if you have little or no experience with project management. It can be a good way to break into the field. However, if you have at least three years of project management experience, it's worth considering the PMP. </p><p><b>Read more:</b> <a href="https://www.coursera.org/articles/capm-certification-guide" target="_self" rel="">CAPM vs. PMP: Which is Best for You?</a></p></div></div></div><div class="css-175sjpy"><div class="css-i5ivod"><img alt="" src="https://d3njjcbhbojbot.cloudfront.net/api/utilities/v1/imageproxy/https://coursera_assets.s3.amazonaws.com/articles/purple-hash-pattern.svg?auto=format%2Ccompress&dpr=2&blur=200&px=8&max-w=252" class="css-3gbnhs"/><div class="lazyload-wrapper"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div></div></div></div></div><h2 id="3-how-to-prepare-for-the-capm-exam">How to prepare for the CAPM exam</h2><p>To train for the CAPM exam, you can self-study or enroll in a course. Here’s a quick look at two online training courses.</p><h3>Project Management Basics</h3><p>

Requirements and More What Is the CAPM Certification? Requirements and More Written by Coursera Staff • Updated on Oct 30, 2025 The CAPM—or Certified Associate in Project Management—certification is designed to help candidates learn the skills necessary for entry-level project management positions. It can be the first stepping stone to a career in the field. Key takeaways A few things to know: The CAPM certification (Certified Associate in Project Management) is an entry-level certification offered by PMI (Project Management Institute). It’s designed for individuals who are starting out in project management or want to demonstrate foundational knowledge of project management principles. Earning a CAPM certification can help you stand out as a candidate for entry-level project management roles. Through studying for the CAPM exam, you'll learn the principles of project management and earn credentials that demonstrate your knowledge of proven frameworks and methodologies. In the following article, you'll learn how to prepare, earn, and use your CAPM certification to advance your project management career. You can prepare for the CAPM certification exam with Pearson's Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) Exam Specialization , where you'll review tailored learning strategies and test-taking techniques to suit your personal learning style. Best CAPM Certification courses for beginners Top-rated beginner-friendly CAPM Certification courses with no prerequisites. 1 PMP Certification Pearson Beginner 1 - 3 Months Specialization 4.6 (57) 2 Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)® Exam Pearson Beginner 1 - 3 Months Specialization 4.6 (63) 3 PMP Exam Prep Certification Training University of Maryland, College Park Beginner 3 - 6 Months Specialization 4.6 (284) What is CAPM certification? The Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)® certification is a credential designed to demonstrate entry-level project management competency. It is administered by the Project Management Institute (PMI), a leading worldwide organization in project management. This certificate can also be used as a stepping stone to the Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification . CAPM requirements You’ll need to meet the following requirements to sit for the CAPM exam: A high school diploma, GED, associate degree, or equivalent 23 hours of project management education completed before the time of the exam Once you've completed at least 23 hours of education, you're qualified to take the exam. The CAPM exam contains 150 questions and you’ll have three hours to complete it. What counts as 23 hours of project management education? You may search for in-person courses at your local community college or take online project management programs, such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate . Throughout this series, you'll focus on core project management skills and methodologies like Agile, risk management, project execution, business writing, and effective communication. How much does a CAPM certification cost? The CAPM exam costs $225 for PMI members and $300 for non-members [ 1 ]. Becoming a PMI member costs $129 a year, plus a one-time $10 application fee. Membership includes perks such as a complimentary download of the PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) Guide, lower costs for other career-advancing certifications, and access to a project management job board. Is the CAPM certification worth it for your career? Certifications are a great way to improve your job performance, confidence in the workplace, and competitiveness as an applicant. If you're unsure whether or not the CAPM certification aligns with your career goals, consider browsing job postings for careers you'd like to pursue. If the skills match the ones being tested in the CAPM exam or employers ask for the CAPM by name, earning the certificate can help you meet those expectations. In the following sections, you can learn more about jobs that benefit from or specifically request CAPM certification and their respective salaries. Entry-level project management jobs The CAPM can prepare you for entry-level project management jobs, such as project coordinator and associate project manager. Project management is a growing career field. According to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), the job outlook for project management specialists is expected to grow 6 percent between 2024 and 2034, faster than the average for all occupations [ 2 ]. In a report published by the PMI, the project-oriented job market is projected to grow 33 percent, equivalent to 22 million new jobs, and by 2027, employers are projected to need almost 88 million project management roles [ 3 ]. How much does a CAPM certification increase salary? According to Payscale, a Certified Associate in Project Management makes an average salary of $77,000 in the US as of October 2025 [ 4 ]. Below are some of the average US salaries for positions listing CAPM certification in job postings, collected from Glassdoor. Position Salary Project coordinator $62,848 Junior project manager $66,303 Associate project manager $77,335 Project analyst $73,940 Project manager $89,260 Project control specialist $98,260 Read more: Project Manager Salary: Your 2024 Guide Should I get the CAPM or PMP? Whether you should get the CAPM vs. PMP depends on your goals. CAPM certification makes sense if you have little or no experience with project management. It can be a good way to break into the field. However, if you have at least three years of project management experience, it's worth considering the PMP. Read more: CAPM vs. PMP: Which is Best for You? How to prepare for the CAPM exam To train for the CAPM exam, you can self-study or enroll in a course. Here’s a quick look at two online training courses. Project Management Basics What you need to know: Project Management Basics is a course offered by the PMI designed to prepare you for the CAPM. Lessons are 20-minute online modules that are accessible in any order. The course is based on content in the PMI project management guide, A Guide to the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK Guide), and includes a free digital copy of the guide. Price: $400 for non-PMI members, $350 for PMI members Google Project Management: Professional Certificate What you need to know: The Google Project Management: Professional Certificate includes six courses on various aspects of project management, including project initiation, project planning, and agile project management. Completing the coursework will also earn you a professional certificate, and qualifies you with over 100 hours of project management education that you can use toward requirements for PMI certifications, the CAPM included. The certificate is not an official CAPM training course. Price: Included with Coursera Plus subscription. Opting to self-study? You’ll want to at least get a copy of the most recent PMBOK Guide, which the CAPM is based on. You can also start getting acquainted with the contents and structure of the exam through the PMI’s CAPM handbook .
